description: This file contains a test script that sets up and verifies the behavior of Git worktrees, specifically focusing on refs, HEAD resolutions, reflogs, and for-each-ref commands related to worktrees in a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success

methods.description: Creates a new commit in the specified repository or path.

methods.description: Sets cleanup commands to run after test execution.
